comment: 1 after Cos_Initialize, cleared by Cos_Terminate (original name bcosInitialize, libchore.so)
1 after Cos_Startup allocated the tables, cleared by Cos_Shutdown (bcosStartup)
The host's service table (assert, alloc/free/realloc, fopen/fclose/fgets/fprintf), set by Cos_Initialize (pcosHS)
Costume slots counted in use (numCostumes); not lowered when a load fails, see build/overrides_s1_chore.c
Size of g_aCostumes in records (maxCostumes; 32 at start-up, grows by 8)
The costume table (aCostumes): g_nMaxCostumes records of 0x3c bytes (Costume); a costume handle is index + 1
Registered component tags (numComponentTags)
Size of g_aComponentTags (maxComponentTags, 32)
The component tag table (aComponentTags): records of 0x5c bytes (ComponentTag: id, kind, name, user data, seven handlers) registered by Cos_NewStateBasedTag / Cos_NewIntTag / Cos_NewFloatTag
Costume instance records counted in use (numInstances)
Size of g_aCostumeInstances in records (maxInstances; 32 at start-up, grows by 8)
The costume instance table (aCostumeInstances): records of 0x14 bytes (CosInstance); an instance handle is index + 1
Text costume loader: component index in the file -> component index in the costume (aComponentLookups), grown to the largest component count read
Size of g_aComponentLookups (numComponentLookups)
CosUtil_RegisterCompNotifier: called (costume, component, index, added) when a component is added or deleted (pCompNotifier)
CosUtil_RegisterBitmapMunger: turns a state bitmap description into the value kept at +0x10 of the state bitmap record (pBitmapMunger)
Cos_RegisterInstanceHook: called (instance, created) when a costume instance is created (1, may refuse with 0) or freed (0) (instanceHook)
Cos_RegisterSaveHook: asked (file name, costume handle) before CosUtil_Write writes a costume (saveHook)
Cos_RegisterSaveVerify: decides (costume) whether Cos_Save writes a loaded costume into the save game (cosSaveVerify)
Lines read by Cos_ReadLine from the costume file being loaded (LineNum)
Serial number for the next costume record, Costume +0x24 (the static Cos_NewEntry.nextID)
Line buffer of the text costume loader, 0x400 bytes (aParseLine)
Tag index of the costume file -> index into g_aComponentTags (loader: Cos_ReadTagsSection; writer: Cos_CollectUsedTags), 100 entries (aTagLookups)
